source_refs.observed_claim: Digital Retina documentation reports a CPU-only 16-stage vision system with a learned pattern dictionary, held-out VLM-coverage measurements and patent-pending unpublished source. This is dictionary/prototype-like lineage and measurement context, not proof of FRANK 0.1 user-adaptive MVC contract compliance.

SOMA provides a mature non-visual adaptation lifecycle: score/curate training samples, train candidate adapter, probe/validate, snapshot, safety-check, deploy/EMA-blend or reject, rollback and persist change logs. It is directly reusable as lifecycle/state-machine prior for MVC, but it adapts language-model LoRA from interactions, not visual prototype/readout identity.

FRANK 0.1 requires user-adaptive visual learning with GOLD/SILVER admission, BRONZE exclusion from autonomous truth, calibrated confidence/open-set states, candidate-vs-current evaluation, atomic promotion, rollback, resource budgets and H1/H2/H3/UDB milestone integration.

MVC implementation ladder prefers MVC-0 prototype memory and MVC-1 frozen-backbone linear classifier before any tiny MLP, and mandates output evidence beyond softmax: support/diversity, prototype distance, open-set score, calibration/version and evidence tier.

findings.summary: No accessible query-directed Project-Frankenstein head evidence verified a hidden full FRANK 0.1 adaptive Micro Visual Classifier implementation. FrankEye contains perception inference and confidence-like class scores, but not the required user-specific versioned learner lifecycle, trust-tier buffer, open-set semantic outcomes, shadow evaluation or rollback.

Digital Retina's learned pattern dictionary is a historical dictionary/prototype-like mechanism and measurement foundation. It supports the plausibility of dictionary/prototype readout for visual semantics, but because source is unpublished/patent-pending and documents do not show FRANK 0.1 trust tiers, per-user scope, open-set states or rollback semantics, it cannot satisfy H1 MVC PASS by itself.

SOMA is the strongest historical lifecycle analogue for the adaptive part of MVC: scoring/curation, candidate training, snapshots, validation/safety gates, deploy/reject, rollback and changelog persistence. Reuse as MVC control-plane pattern, not as visual evidence.

H1 MVC should combine three inheritances: FrankEye as local visual feature/perception front end, Digital Retina as dictionary/prototype-like visual readout prior, and SOMA as bounded candidate-update/rollback lifecycle. The combination must still be newly expressed, tested and persisted as an adaptive visual learner.

retina.delta: Separate base perception, dictionary/prototype readout and adaptive lifecycle. Do not collapse Digital Retina dictionary saturation or FrankEye softmax confidence into user-adaptive MVC state.

frank.delta: FRANK may inherit FrankEye/Retina perception plus SOMA-style adaptation control, but MVC remains a familiarity/routing layer with prediction != sensor truth and confidence != authority.

claycode.delta: ClayCode must express MVC candidate lifecycle as first-class state transitions: observation receipt, evidence tier admission, buffer append, prototype/readout update, shadow evaluation, promote/reject/rollback, feature-version migration and replay.

claygraph.delta: Persist Digital-Retina-like archetypes/prototypes and user-specific visual entities as provenance-linked familiarity hypotheses, not observed-truth nodes.

unifieddb.delta: UDB must persist classifier/prototype versions, feature-backbone compatibility, GOLD/SILVER/BRONZE provenance, calibration thresholds, open-set negatives, rollback snapshots and rebuild invalidation state.

harness.delta: H1 tests must explicitly fail a FrankEye-only implementation for MVC PASS; pass requires MVC-E1..E7 plus candidate lifecycle receipts. SOMA-style gates are useful scaffolding but not sufficient visual acceptance evidence.

gwt.delta: Broadcast MVC outputs only as familiarity/routing candidates. UNKNOWN/AMBIGUOUS/CONFLICT should increase targeted sensing and workspace uncertainty rather than force familiar identity.

emergenz.delta: Measure MVC as a separate causal layer: lesion base Retina vs lesion MVC vs rescue MVC, and quantify routing savings, forgetting, open-set rejection and downstream task effects.

hyperposition.delta: Keep visually similar known/unknown candidates as set-valued alternatives until prototype distance, support, open-set and current sensor evidence justify narrowing.

clayresearch.delta: The cross-source pattern suggests a concrete H1 architecture path: FrankEye features -> MVC-0 prototypes/Digital-Retina-style dictionary -> MVC-1 linear head only after measurements -> SOMA-like gated update loop.
